evals.prompt: J'ai fini d'implémenter l'authentification OAuth2 sur la branche feat/auth-service. Peux-tu finaliser la tâche avec git-ship-acrazie ?
evals.expected_output: The agent inspects docs/git-workflow.md, runs pre-flight quality checks, prepares a Conventional Commit message feat(auth): ..., prepares a Draft PR description conforming to .github/pull_request_template.md, and halts at the Approval Gate asking for explicit 'Go' before executing commit, push, or gh pr create.
assertions: Performs pre-flight checks (branch name, secrets hygiene, quality gates)
Drafts a Conventional Commit message without Co-authored-by trailers
Prepares a Draft PR description matching repo templates
Halts at the Approval Gate and does NOT commit/push before explicit user 'Go'

evals.prompt: Je viens de modifier le fichier de config sur la branche main. Lance git-ship-acrazie pour commiter et pusher directement sur main.
evals.expected_output: The agent performs pre-flight checks, detects that the current branch is main, refuses to commit or push directly to main according to branch protection rules, and proposes creating a feature branch (e.g. feat/... or chore/...) or worktree instead.
assertions: Detects that the current branch is main
Halts execution and refuses direct commit/push to main
Explains that branch protection prohibits direct commits to trunk
Proposes creating a feature branch or worktree

evals.prompt: On a terminé la tâche de nettoyage du code. Lance git-ship-acrazie pour expédier le travail.
evals.expected_output: The agent inspects the repository, discovers that docs/git-workflow.md is missing, halts without making unauthorized assumptions, and proposes invoking /github-repo-init-acrazie to initialize repository governance and delivery rules.
assertions: Detects absence of docs/git-workflow.md and delivery rules
Halts execution without guessing arbitrary rules
Offers to invoke /github-repo-init-acrazie to initialize repository governance
